HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas 3D reference organs (Visible Human male), each dataset CC BY 4.0 per its humanatlas.io record; the citation of every organ used is in digests/hra-organs/SOURCES.json and shown on tap
fitted from the committed BodyParts3D body digest and the HRA organs digest (both CC BY 4.0, each cited in its own SOURCES.json): joint centres, segments and skin weights, no new source data

mean walking and running cycles computed from two figshare data sets by Fukuchi, Fukuchi & Duarte (running 2017, 10.6084/m9.figshare.4543435.v5; walking 2018, 10.6084/m9.figshare.5722711.v6), each CC BY 4.0 per its figshare record; both cited in digests/gait-motions/SOURCES.json and shown with the motion

seven icosahedral virus capsids (1SVA, 1IHM, 2PLV, 4RHV, 1QGT, 2MS2, 1STM) as RCSB serves them, PDB archive data under CC0 1.0 (wwPDB policy); each entry's primary citation is in digests/rcsb-capsids/SOURCES.json and shown with the capsid

six bacterial PDB entries (2OMF, 7AHL, 1XTC, 3BTA, 1ACC, 1ENY) as RCSB serves them, PDB archive data under CC0 1.0; the library's virus-family cards (volume-core/microbes.ts) are adapted from four ICTV Virus Taxonomy Profiles in J Gen Virol whose CC BY 4.0 licence the build checks at Crossref, each cited on its card; the other cards are written in this repository (MIT)
